---
title: "Simulator test reference"
---

## Environment

- macOS with a desktop session and Python 3.10 or newer.
- Connect IQ SDK 9.3.0 or newer and the Venu 4 45 mm profile (`venu445mm`).
- The private Android companion source at `~/src/garmin-voicenotes-companion`. Set `VOICENOTES_COMPANION_DIR` if you keep it elsewhere.
- JDK 11 or newer, Android SDK build-tools 36.0.0, Android platform `android-37.0`, and ADB. Set `ANDROID_HOME` or `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT` if the SDK is elsewhere.
- The default AVD is `Medium_Phone_API_37.0`. The receiver’s default port, 8787, must be idle during the run.

## Recipes

| Recipe | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `just garmin-run-fixture` | Builds and loads the watch fixture for the manual demo. |
| `just android-build` | Builds `bin/android/Voicenotes-debug.apk`. |
| `just android-emulator [avd]` | Boots the selected virtual phone. |
| `just test-simulator [serial]` | Requires foreground delivery and reconnect recovery. Records the background result. |
| `just test-simulator-background [serial]` | Also requires delivery while the watch app is exited. |

The suite installs `bin/android/Voicenotes-test.apk` under `ch.voicenotes.inbox.e2e` and runs a separate watch app named `VNE2E`. Each run starts with empty test app storage. The Android test inbox listens on emulator port 17381. The runner relays the Garmin tether on host port 7381 and restores an existing direct forward for the selected emulator after the test.

## Assertions and artifacts

| Check | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Foreground delivery | Two-way message, watch receipt, complete WAV hash, and Android playback completion without input. |
| Interrupted transfer | The Android inbox restarts with a partial file. The next offer resumes at the saved offset. Exactly one final WAV exists for that note ID. |
| Watch app exited | A fresh note is queued before exit. The runner observes whether Android saves it within 25 seconds of an Android sync request and verifies delivery of the same note after reopening. |

The fixture is a 32,044-byte WAV with SHA-256 `953ea453dce7245c7e2153012000d3bf686cee2b75cc6d30f60da90812b64022`. The runner writes logs, verified WAVs, and the background result to `.tools/simulator-tests/<run>/` as it completes each check. The background result is in `background.txt`.

[Garmin simulator connection guide](https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/articles/core-topics/Communicating_with_Mobile_Apps.html)
